annotations.title: Run an approved creator post as a paused ad

description: Run an APPROVED campaign post as an ad, from the creator's own code. Instagram / Facebook post: a Meta partnership ad on a new paused campaign + ad set (adCode = the creator's partnership ad code: post > ... > Partnership label and ads > Ad code). TikTok post: a Spark Ad in an existing ad group (adCode = the Spark Ads code the creator shares from that post; adgroupId required). Created PAUSED and read back; nothing spends until switched on. Without confirm:true, a preview that builds nothing. Usage rights never block it: if the rights this creator agreed to on the join page do not list that platform or have ended, the note carries a one-line heads-up the brand may ignore (they may have agreed elsewhere).

adgroupId.description: TikTok: the ad group to add it to

dailyBudgetUsd.description: Meta, in the ad account's currency (default 10)
